names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 24 ianuarie, «Sfânta Cuvioasă Xenia din Roma».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Ιανουαρίου, «Οσίες Ξένη και οι δύο θεραπαινίδες της», with the rank word left off.

hymns.text: Întru tine, maică, cu osârdie s-a mântuit cel după chip; că, luând crucea, ai urmat lui Hristos; şi lucrând, ai învăţat să nu se uite la trup, căci este trecător; ci, să poarte grijă de suflet, de lucrul cel nemuritor. Pentru aceasta şi cu îngerii împreună se bucură, Preacuvioasă Maică Xenia, duhul tău.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfintei Cuvioase Xenia, Glasul 8

english.text: In thee, O mother, that which was made after God's image was saved with diligence; for taking up the cross thou didst follow Christ, and by thy labour thou didst teach men to overlook the flesh, for it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal. Therefore does thy spirit rejoice with the angels, O most venerable mother Xenia.

hymns.text: Pomenirea ta cea minunată, Sfântă Preacuvioasă Xenia, săvârşind-o noi, cei ce te cinstim pe tine cu dragoste, lăudăm pe Hristos, Cel Ce ţi-a dat ţie întru toate putere de tămăduire; pe Acela totdeauna roagă-L pentru noi toţi.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfintei Cuvioase Xenia, Glasul 2, «Cu curgerile sângiurilor...»

english.text: Keeping thy wonderful memory, O most venerable Saint Xenia, we who honour thee with love praise Christ, who gave thee power to heal in all things; and him do thou pray always for us all.

hymns.text: Ἐν σοί Μῆτερ ἀκριβῶς διεσώθη τό κατ᾽ εἰκόνα· λαβοῦσα γάρ τόν σταυρόν, ἠκολούθησας τῷ Χριστῷ, καί πράττουσα ἐδίδασκες, ὑπεροράν μέν σαρκός, παρέρχεται γάρ· ἐπιμελεῖσθαι δέ ψυχῆς, πράγματος ἀθανάτoυ, διό καί μετά Ἀγγέλων συναγάλλεται, Ὁσία Ξένη τό πνεῦμά σου.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, the first of two the page prints, on the page of Οσία Ξένη. It is the common of a woman ascetic, with her name in the last clause.

english.text: In thee, O Mother, that which was according to the image was kept safe exactly; for taking up the cross thou didst follow Christ, and by thy doing thou didst teach us to look past the flesh, since it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal. Therefore thy spirit, O venerable Xenia, rejoices together with the angels.

hymns.text: Ξένην ἤνυσας, ζωὴν ἐν κόσμῳ, ξένην ἔσχηκας, προσηγορίαν, ὑπεμφαίνουσαν τὴ κλήσει τὸν τρόπον σου, σὺ γὰρ νυμφίον λιποῦσα τὸν πρόσκαιρον, τῷ ἀθανάτῳ ὁσίως νενύμφευσαι. Ξένη ἔνδοξε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr — Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως, the second of two the page prints, on the page of Οσία Ξένη

english.text: A stranger's life thou didst accomplish in the world, and a stranger's name thou didst bear, which shows thy manner of life in its very calling; for thou didst leave the bridegroom of a moment, and wast wedded in holiness to the immortal one. Glorious Xenia, entreat Christ God to grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Τό σόν ξενότροπον Ξένη μνημόσυνον, ἐπιτελοῦντες οἱ πόθῳ τιμῶντές σε, ὑμνοῦμεν Χριστόν τόν ἐν ἅπασι, σοί παρέχοντα ἰσχύν τῶν ἰάσεων· ὅν πάντοτε δυσώπει, ὑπέρ πάντων ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τοῖς τῶν αἱμάτων σου, on the page of Οσία Ξένη. The page prints the Οἶκος after it, which is not copied here.

english.text: Keeping thy strange-fashioned memorial, O Xenia, we who honour thee with longing hymn Christ, who in all things gives thee the strength of healings; entreat him without ceasing for us all.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 24 ianuarie — «Sfânta Cuvioasă Xenia din Roma»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Ιανουαρίου — «Οσίες Ξένη και οι δύο θεραπαινίδες της»

attestations.note: The line commemorates her two maidservants with her. saint.gr heads them «Οσιες Δυο Θεραπαινιδες Της Οσιας Ξενης» and prints a distich for them, but never names either of them, so they have no folder of their own.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Η Οσία Ξένη έζησε τον 5ο μ.Χ. αιώνα». The page states the century she lived in and no year of birth or repose; doxologia.ro, cited on this folder's Romanian row, gave no year at all.
